description: This Java class 'ProgramWorkflowEditor' extends 'OpenmrsPropertyEditor' to serialize and deserialize 'ProgramWorkflow' objects, supporting lookup by ID and UUID, used for form data processing within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowEditor
classes.description: A property editor for serializing and deserializing 'ProgramWorkflow' objects, enabling lookup by ID and UUID for form handling.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a 'ProgramWorkflow' object by its ID using the ProgramWorkflowService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a 'ProgramWorkflow' object by its UUID using the ProgramWorkflowService.
